notes.title: 1,000+ Wishlists – Thank You, Snipers!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587105/fb66d56f0a663a6b92e89a5d0d1d1bf806929df6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Marksmen![/p][p]We’ve just hit an incredible milestone, and we have you to thank for it: [b]MARKSMAN VR has officially surpassed 1,000 wishlists on Steam![/b] 🥳[/p][p]As a small indie team, seeing this kind of support is beyond what we could have imagined. Every single wishlist fuels our passion, motivates our late-night coding sessions, and confirms that we’re on the right track to making the best VR sniping experience possible. Your belief in our vision means the world to us.[/p][p]We are fully committed to bringing this game to life and are working tirelessly on our upcoming milestones, including the [b]demo release[/b] and the [b]Early Access launch![/b] 🚀[/p][p]Thank you for being the foundation of our growing community. This is just the beginning of our mission, and we can’t wait to share what’s next with you.[/p][p]Stay sharp for more updates very soon…[/p][p]— The Crimson Gate Team[/p]

notes.title: We’re Not in Next Fest – But We’re Still On Target
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587105/16475c70984b7e3e6dd40edd6d70d6753a9887f1.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We had originally planned to bring [b]MARKSMAN VR[/b] to Steam Next Fest this June. Due to some timing and submission limitations, we won’t be part of the event this time.[/p][p]But in the meantime, we’ve made great progress — focusing all our efforts on improving the game and fine-tuning the experience.[/p][p]Thanks to your support, [b]MARKSMAN VR has now passed 500+ wishlists[/b], and the community continues to grow. Every bit of feedback, every wishlist, and every message of encouragement means a lot to us.[/p][p]We’re fully locked in on making the full release as polished and exciting as possible — and we can’t wait to show you more.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned — more updates are just around the corner.[/b][/p][p]— The Crimson Gate Team[/p]

notes.title: 250+ Wishlists – Thank You Snipers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587105/13d413b6640da88bcd2013df39b2c8ed7ddf1a44.png[/img]

MARKSMAN VR has officially [i][b]crossed 250 wishlists[/b][/i] on Steam!

We’re incredibly thankful for the interest and support from all of you. Every wishlist brings us one step closer to launch — and motivates us even more to deliver the best VR sniping experience possible.

Until then, stay hidden, stay sharp...

🎯 And if you haven’t wishlisted yet — now’s the perfect time!
